newsitem.title: USA: Maine's consumer confidence hits five-year high.
newsitem.headline: Maine's consumer confidence hits five-year high.

text.p: A survey of Maine's consumers found the highest level in five years, according to Market Decisions.
Twenty-eight percent of those surveyed say they believe Maine's economy is better today than it was 12-months ago.
But survey analysts caution the survey numbers do not necessarily reflect what Mainers think about their own economic well being.
The survey of 400 Mainers was conducted by telephone last month.
